record.what_it_does: Linear is an issue-tracking and project-management tool for software teams, exposing a GraphQL API for reading and writing issues, projects, cycles, teams, and related objects.
record.auth_notes: OAuth2 supports authorization-code flow (with PKCE), refresh tokens, and a client_credentials grant for server-to-server 'app' actor tokens; recommended for apps built for other users. Personal API keys (created in Security & access settings) are simplest for single-user/personal scripts and are passed raw in the Authorization header (not prefixed 'Bearer').
record.access_notes: Free plan ($0) explicitly includes 'API and webhook access' and 'MCP access'; personal API keys and OAuth2 app creation are available immediately to any developer without approval or payment.

evidence.quote: The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
We support the client_credentials grant type for OAuth2 apps that use tokens for server-to-server communication
Visit Security & access settings to create and manage them.
Linear's public API is built using GraphQL.
Our MCP server uses Streamable HTTP as the primary transport, accessible at the following address... https://mcp.linear.app/mcp
